build_rmae_model: build a RegionQueryRMAE model from an omegaconf config with rmae_base_patch16 or rmae_large_patch16 arch
create_region_masked_autoencoder: create a RegionMaskedAutoencoderViT with custom mask ratio, region loss weight, and region sample type
run_random_masking: run per-sample random masking on a sequence tensor with optional region-aware masking and shuffle ids
forward_region_decoder: forward pass the region decoder to predict region patches from region latent and memory cross-attention
forward_loss: compute combined MAE and region binary cross-entropy loss with configurable loss weights and mask weighting
